# Backend Engineer, Payments

Northwind Labs, Bengaluru. 2 to 5 years of experience with Node.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL.

You will build the services that move money for our merchants: payment intents, refunds, payouts and the ledger behind them. The team owns its APIs end to end, from design reviews to on-call, and works closely with risk and finance on reconciliation. We value clear writing, small pull requests and careful migrations.

Verdict: match
